The valuation of the land at Manton Wood, on which a logistics property would be developed on as at 3 June 2025 is S$22.9 million... using the residual method.' Land valuation table (p6870-6871): Towcester carrying 85,111; Manton Wood ('Mantonwood') carrying 21,316 ('000 SGD).
transactions.notes: Two freehold greenfield development plots (Manton Wood + Towcester) treated as a single deal_id per property_slug convention since both counterparty and completion context are shared; land cost only (S$94.608m), not the total committed development cost of S$350.1m (which includes future construction spend for four buildings across the two sites). Exact completion day not disclosed in the AR narrative -- only 'in 2025' / valuation reference date 3 Jun 2025; completed_date left null rather than guessed. S$18,818k of the purchase price was deferred/unpaid at year-end per our prior extraction's Note 5 citation.
